PACK BURST P6p-matrix-2 — matrix.html, the front door for Matt's verdict session (Run C-3 P6). task_id "P6p-matrix-2".

Inputs (read-only): /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/matrix_index.json (per cell: status, sources, clip version, flags, transcriber disagreements, packet path given relative to cells/ — rewrite it relative to runs/C-3/); /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/P6c-numbers-2/numbers.json (uniform numbers + definitions); each cell's packet directory /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/<pack_burst>/packet/ (take img/strip.png as the thumbnail); /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/P2p-turnaround/review.html; /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/P5p-gear-idle-S-r1/packet/review.html and /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/P5p-gear-walk-E-r1/packet/review.html; /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/P5p-vfx/review.html; /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/viewer/index.html; /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/godot/project.godot.

Write out/matrix.html — ONE self-contained page that will be placed at runs/C-3/matrix.html, so every link is RELATIVE to runs/C-3/ (e.g. artifacts/P4p-S-walk/packet/review.html, viewer/index.html, godot/README.md); copy each thumbnail into out/thumbs/<cell>.png and reference it as thumbs/<cell>.png. No external resources, no scripts from the web. Layout: (1) title 'Run C-3 — the Keeper matrix (verdict-ready, not the verdict)'; (2) a FRONT PAGE box listing, in this order, exactly these items as bullet points:
   - STATUS: Run C-3 was HALTED twice — H-C3-1 (Grok balance exhausted after 53/56 clips) and H-C3-2 (jack-ryan Gate-2 BLOCK: the conductor had re-scoped your 'HALT and stop' rule and kept working). Conceded (R-C3-22). You topped up and said 'complete the matrix' (R-C3-24): 11 more clips, all 40 cells now complete. Q78(a) — ratify the post-halt work — is still owed in words.
   - R-C3-1 GEOMETRY: the C-2 E frame (R-43) was a mirrored body — your question was right; the turnaround follows the derived table (staff NEAR on E/SE/NE). Gate-2: the physics holds.
   - GLYPH (R-C3-14): judge picked glyph A (needle through three strata) — ratify or swap.
   - GEAR (Q75, R-C3-19): a whole-sheet edit re-renders the body; the gear LAYER cut from it is motion-identical. Only idle S and walk E have the advanced set.
   - HEAD-DOWN: after one gaze re-generation, walk E / walk SW / walk NW / run SE / jump SW are head-up; walk W kept its head-down original (the head-up re-generation had no cuttable cycle); walk NE and jump NW read head-down on BOTH attempts — both are back three-quarter views, probably the transcriber misreading an averted head. Your eye rules.
   - CORRECTIONS from Gate-2 (R-C3-23): 'T3 FAIL' was never defined (T3b and T3c each missed a real-data acceptance clause); the head-pitch proxy sees no head-down at all; the one-shot key poses (jump/cast) were chosen by conductor scripts, not a tested instrument; 22 of 40 cells (run/jump/cast) have NO proposed band; the viewer wheel is plain HTML/canvas (NOT Pixi) and has not been played.
   - Every number here is a report, not a pass or fail. Your eye rules each cell.
(3) links row: Turnaround (packet 20) · Gear (idle S, walk E) · VFX · viewer wheel — plain HTML, not Pixi (viewer/index.html) · Godot stub (open runs/C-3/godot/project.godot in Godot 4.6: arrows/WASD move, Shift run, Space jump, E cast, G gear) · numbers.csv; (4) the MATRIX: a table with rows S SE E NE N NW W SW and columns idle walk run jump cast; each cell = thumbnail linking to its packet, a one-line badge (clip v1/v2; frames@fps), up to 4 small numbers from numbers.json (G6b, G1 max, closure, motion range) with their definitions in a legend below, a red-bordered list of flags and transcriber disagreements (plain words), and for INCOMPLETE cells a grey box with the reason (there should be none now); (5) a legend with every number definition from numbers.json and the sentence 'All numbers are reports against proposed bands; none is a pass or fail.'; (6) a blank 'Matt's verdict' column per row (a text cell reading 'rule at C-4').
Also write out/summary.txt (≤ 12 lines: counts complete/incomplete, the front-page items in one line each). No image_gen. No code beyond the page. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0. BUDGET 12 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "P6p-matrix-2"; images []; files: out/matrix.html, out/summary.txt, every out/thumbs/* with sha256; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
